description: This file defines the IndexModel class for the Basket page in an ASP.NET Core Razor Pages application. It handles basket-related operations like viewing, adding items, and updating quantities, leveraging services and repositories for business logic.

classes.name: IndexModel
classes.description: PageModel for the Basket index page, managing basket display and updates.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to load the basket for the current user or guest.

methods.name: OnPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a product to the basket.

methods.name: OnPostUpdate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update quantities of basket items.

methods.name: GetOrSetBasketCookieAndUserName
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cookie-based username for anonymous users or uses the authenticated user name.
